mapper.sql: select v.id, v.product_key, v.device_id, v.iot_id, v.package_type, v.custom_type, v.module, v.current_version, v.target_version, v.hardware_version, v.last_task_id, v.last_status, v.protocol, v.retry_count, v.status_detail, v.ext_info, v.create_time, v.update_time, v.last_report_time, v.last_success_time, d.device_name from iot_ota_device_version v left join iot_device d on d.product_key = v.product_key and d.device_id = v.device_id
mapper.select: where v.product_key = #{productKey} order by v.last_report_time desc, v.id desc

select current_version as version, count(*) as count from iot_ota_device_version where product_key = #{productKey} and current_version is not null and current_version != '' group by current_version order by count(*) desc, current_version desc limit 10
mapper.insert: insert into iot_ota_device_version (product_key, device_id, iot_id, package_type, custom_type, module, current_version, target_version, hardware_version, last_task_id, last_status, protocol, retry_count, status_detail, ext_info, create_time, update_time, last_report_time, last_success_time) values (#{productKey}, #{deviceId}, #{iotId}, #{packageType}, #{customType}, #{module}, #{currentVersion}, #{targetVersion}, #{hardwareVersion}, #{lastTaskId}, #{lastStatus}, #{protocol}, #{retryCount}, #{statusDetail}, #{extInfo}, now(), now(), #{lastReportTime}, #{lastSuccessTime}) on duplicate key update iot_id = values(iot_id), custom_type = values(custom_type), current_version = values(current_version), target_version = values(target_version), hardware_version = values(hardware_version), last_task_id = values(last_task_id), last_status = values(last_status), protocol = values(protocol), retry_count = values(retry_count), status_detail = values(status_detail), ext_info = values(ext_info), update_time = now(), last_report_time = values(last_report_time), last_success_time = values(last_success_time)
